subject: Re: Edge hosting — connectivity catalog, IO allocation & cross-connect playbook
messages:
From: Tom Reyes <tom@mednova.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-15T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: New private site intake — rack + crossconnect constraints

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks again for the quick intake. High level constraints from our operations and compliance teams so you have context before the design:
- Physical: 2 full racks in our primary colo (Site A), redundant PDUs, 10Gb leaf/leaf between racks, dedicated 40Gb crossconnect to our compute fabric.
- Storage: ~1PB usable for object/archive (S3-equivalent) and ~120TB of block storage for model checkpoints with 5000-8000 IOPS sustained per TB for the active tier.
- Caching: we'd like local NVMe per node for model KV cache with fallback to network blockstore.
- Networking: no direct public egress from the cluster; all outbound must go through our egress proxy with allowed destination list. BGP peering with our edge router anticipated.
- Compliance: data residency in US only; we will need a SOC2 evidence packet and an audit point for persistent disk encryption.

Attached: mednova-data-retention.pdf (policy overview) and a draft crossconnect spreadsheet.

Can you outline a recommended node mix and storage topology that meets the IOPS targets and minimizes cross-rack traffic for model inference workloads? Also include lead times for crossconnect provisioning and any prerequisites from our side (cabling, VLANs, IP ranges).

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Reyes
Head of Infrastructure — MedNova Health
ops@mednova.com

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reyes <tom@mednova.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New private site intake — rack + crossconnect constraints

Tom — thanks for the clarity, this is really helpful. Draft thoughts below; attaching a compact layout PDF with diagrams (redwood-proposal-cluster-layout-v1.pdf).

High-level cluster footprint (proposal):
- Control plane: 3x m6-standard (dedicated management VLAN, nodes in single-rack spread for HA).
- Infra/mgmt: 2x m6 for logging/metrics, + 1x small bastion for on-call access.
- Worker pools:
  - worker-inference-highio: 8x r5d.12 (local NVMe: 2x 3.84TB per host) — primary cache for model KV and low-latency token generation.
  - worker-training-checkpoint: 6x c6a.8 with 100TB aggregated blockstore mounts (replicated PVs) for checkpoint restore/backup windows.
  - worker-burst: 2x g5 or equivalent for higher throughput model variants (if you want GPU inference burst).

Storage architecture (to hit stated IOPS):
- Local NVMe per inference node for KV/LM cache (best latency). Configure ephemeral-local PVCs and a node-affinity policy so heavy inference pods prefer these nodes.
- Network blockstore for durable checkpoints: recommend a SAN-style iSCSI/FC or an external block array with multipath (we've seen stable IOPS using a 3-node NVMe-oF fronted array). Provide LUNs per tenant and configure the CSI driver for volume snapshots.
- Object archive: recommend an on-site S3-compatible appliance (or connect to your cloud S3 tier over the egress proxy) — decide based on legal retention.

Networking and crossconnect: 
- We need two VLANs from your router: management (private) and customer-data (k8s pod/host traffic).
- BGP peering is preferred for failover; we'll hand you our ASN and expected prefixes.
- Recommend 40Gb crossconnect terminated into a Leaf-to-Leaf pair with port-channel (to avoid single-link contention).
- IP plan: please provide /22 for pod overlay and /24 for node management; we will publish required ranges and NAT exceptions for the egress proxy.

Operational asks / lead times:
- Crossconnect provisioning: typical colo lead time 10–14 business days after VLAN/IP confirmation.
- Rack power and PDUs: we need PDUs with remote power-cycle and rack elevations documented before OS image push.
- KMS integration: to support at-rest encryption we need access to your KMS endpoints / key-wrapping flows — we can support both AWS KMS and on-prem HSM.

Open questions for MedNova:
1) Do you require air-gapped deployment (no software updates from internet)?
2) Preferred replication factor for the checkpoint blockstore (2x async or 3x sync)?
3) Any approved L2/L3 vendors for crossconnect installation?

Next steps I propose: 30-min technical alignment call (network + storage owners) and once we confirm VLANs I'll convert the proposal into an operational runbook.

— Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-proposal-cluster-layout-v1.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reyes <tom@mednova.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-17T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New private site intake — rack + crossconnect constraints

Adding a few network-level checks from our side:
- Please confirm whether the 10Gb leaf/leaf you mentioned is used purely for intra-rack L2 or carries routed L3 between racks. It changes our MTU and overlay tuning.
- For BGP: do you prefer ebgp between edge routers and Redwood's edge, or an iBGP session inside your fabric? We typically prefer ebgp at the colo for clearer failover.
- We'd like a topology diagram of the colo switch leaves (vendor/model + OS) so we can validate jumbo frames and MTU settings for NVMe-oF/ROCE if you select that path.

Also: if the crossconnect is provisioned via a third-party installer we'll need the installer contact for on-site handoff windows (constrains for pre-cabling).

On the storage IOPS note — we'll dimension the block array to exceed peak IOPS by 25% headroom; Neha, can you confirm the default PV reclaim and I/O QoS settings we'll propose to the customer?

Thanks,
Laura
Director, Product Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Tom Reyes <tom@mednova.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-18T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New private site intake — rack + crossconnect constraints

Karthik / Laura — this looks great. Quick clarifications from my infra team:
- The 10Gb leaf/leaf is L2 inside the rack; we will terminate the 40Gb crossconnect as routed L3 at the top-of-rack aggregator so BGP at the colo edge is preferable.
- We will provide the switch vendor and serials in a separate email (expected by EOD tomorrow).
- Replication: we prefer 3x sync for the checkpoint tier (we can tolerate the extra write latency but want the stronger durability).
- Air-gap: not fully air-gapped — we allow controlled egress via our proxy for patch windows.

IOPS SLA question: what level of monitoring / alerting can Redwood provide? We expect token-level latency and disk-level IOPS dashboards for SLOs. Also, please attach your SOC2 evidence packet — compliance wants to pre-review operational controls.

Attached: mednova-crossconnect-schedule.xlsx

Regards,
Tom

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reyes <tom@mednova.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-19T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New private site intake — rack + crossconnect constraints

Tom — thanks for the confirmations. A few operational items for the runbook (I'll draft and circulate after the call):
- PV / Storage QoS: default pool will expose throttled PV classes: 
  * fast-local-nvme (ephemeral, no snapshot) — best-effort, attached to inference nodes
  * block-durable-syncrepl (replication=3, snapshot-enabled) — for checkpoints
  * archive-object (S3 gateway) — lifecycle to cold 
- I/O quotas: we will set default IOPS per PV at 5k IOPS/TiB for block-durable-syncrepl and allow per-volume overrides via StorageClass annotations.
- Monitoring: we will provide Prometheus + Grafana dashboards for token latency, host NVMe latency, LUN IOPS, and a default alert policy (P2 on sustained 5-min IOPS drop / P1 if >20% degraded across cluster).
- Security: KMS integration steps are included (we'll need key names and ACLs). For SOC2 packet, attaching redwood minimal evidence checklist and a pointer to our compliance drive in the related links.

Action items / next steps: 
1) Schedule 30-min technical alignment (network + storage + security) — propose Tue 2026-10-21 09:00 PT.
2) MedNova to share switch serials + onsite installer contact.
3) Redwood to produce runbook and crossconnect handoff checklist within 3 business days after the call.

I'll send the calendar invite once Tom confirms the time.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Platform Operations Manager — Redwood Inference
